title: Evidence-support check
summary: Test semantic support with original passages, the candidate assertion, and definitions.

sections.label: Proposed pattern
sections.text:
Original source passage
+ proposed assertion
+ relevant ontology definitions
→ supported / contradicted / insufficient evidence
→ evidence-linked reviewer finding

sections.label: Hypothetical scope error
sections.text: A source establishes a banking-sector closure while a candidate record represents a holiday for all employees. A structurally valid record can still misstate the source. This is an example, not an audited workplace defect.

sections.label: Acceptance
sections.text: Measure missed scope errors and false alarms on reviewed examples. Quote/source existence checks and semantic-support judgments are separate components; neither alone proves applicability.

catalog.applicability: Use this explanation to inform decisions. Confirm its fit with your actual environment.
catalog.limits: Reading a topic does not configure tools, execute a workflow or establish passing evidence.
